title: A free base change stays free of the same rank after a further base change
statement: Let $A\to B\to B'$ be homomorphisms of commutative rings, $M$ an $A$-module and $n\ge0$. If $M\otimes_AB$ is a free $B$-module of rank $n$ with basis $e_1,\dots,e_n$, then $M\otimes_AB'$ (with $B'$ an $A$-algebra via $A\to B\to B'$) is a free $B'$-module of rank $n$, with basis the images of $e_1,\dots,e_n$ under the map $M\otimes_AB\to M\otimes_AB'$, $m\otimes b\mapsto m\otimes b'$ ($b'$ the image of $b$). The isomorphism behind this is $(M\otimes_AB)\otimes_BB'\xrightarrow{\sim}M\otimes_AB'$, $(m\otimes b)\otimes c\mapsto m\otimes b'c$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 00D2 (lemma-tensor-with-bimodule, line 1881) with the $(A,B)$-bimodule $N=B$ and $P=B'$: $(M\otimes_AB)\otimes_BB'\cong M\otimes_A(B\otimes_BB')=M\otimes_AB'$; Lemma Tag 00DD (lemma-tensor-products-commute-with-limits, colimits in the first variable, here a finite direct sum): $B^{\oplus n}\otimes_BB'\cong B'^{\oplus n}$
